# Staff AI Engineer — Globex (Berlin)

**Location:** Berlin (hybrid, 2 days/week) · **Type:** Full-time · **Posted:** 2026-08-25

product suite.

## Responsibilities

- Set technical direction for retrieval and agent systems

## Requirements

- 8+ years engineering, 3+ years applied LLM/ML
- Strong Python; TypeScript familiarity
- On-site in Berlin 2 days per week

## Compensation

€130,000–€160,000 + equity.
